records.title: Restoration of Major Rivers in Chhattisgarh
details: a to e: To prevent the discharge of sewage water into rivers, as reported by Chhattisgarh Environment Conservation Board (CECB), there are 24 STPs operational and 16 STPs under construction. Further, it is reported that Faecal Sludge Treatment Plant (FSTP) have been installed in such places where STPs are under construction.

records.title: Objectives of National Cooperative Society Policy.
details: b): Rooted in the principles of cooperation, transparency, and shared ownership, Sahakar Taxi aims to offer a people centric alternative to traditional ride-hailing platforms. The app is in the developing stage and the pilot project is likely to be launched in Delhi and Gujarat.

records.title: Nuclear Energy Generation Capacity
details: c: The Government has announced an ambitious Nuclear Energy Mission with a target of reaching a nuclear power capacity of 100 GW by 2047. To facilitate this mission, necessary amendments will be brought in the Atomic Energy Act and Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act to enable private investment in nuclear power sector.

records.title: Dark Pattern in Mobile/WEB Applications
details: CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION

a to b: A Joint Working Group, comprising representatives from Ministries, National Law Universities and Voluntary Consumer Organizations, has been constituted vide Office Memorandum dated 5th June, 2025 for identifying the dark patterns and stakeholders to work together in creating a transparent, ethical and user-centric online environment.

records.title: Referral of patients from AIIMS Raipur
details: a to f: Establishment of 150 bedded Critical Care Hospital block under Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM) scheme has been approved in AIIMS Raipur.
